label: The capacitive divider
subgoals: Identify the victim's ground and coupling capacitance
Form the coupling over the total capacitance
Multiply by the aggressor's swing to get the peak

label: Several aggressors
subgoals: Sum the couplings of the aggressors that switch together
Use the victim's total capacitance as the denominator
Multiply the ratio by the swing

label: Shielding
subgoals: Reduce the coupling by the fraction the shield absorbs
Keep the victim's total capacitance unchanged
Recompute the divider and take the difference
